name: Open Index
thesis: Treat a returning visitor’s cookbook as a working collection: a photographic index to scan, a category spine to navigate, and one open page to inspect before cooking.
distinctiveChoices: An indexed recipe list and generous live preview replace both the marketing hero and the repeated-card wall.
A numbered collection spine becomes a compact selector on mobile; photograph buttons preview while recipe titles always open the source.
Cool white, graphite, fine rules, systematic typography, and one vermilion accent create an editorial identity without decorative surfaces.
tradeoff: The split view privileges recognition and focused comparison over seeing many large photographs at once. On narrow screens, an explicit preview dialog replaces the persistent open page.
